text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "in Switzerland the president is not the head of state", "gist": "Switzerland's president is not the head of state"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Federal Council", "gist": "Swiss Federal Council"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is extremely rare for all seven members to travel abroad together", "gist": "All seven Federal Council members rarely travel abroad together"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "the few exceptions being the opening of the Simplon tunnel in Domodossola in 1906 and occasional stopovers during Federal Council outings – none of which were considered state visits", "gist": "Exceptions include Simplon tunnel opening in 1906 and some stopovers not classified as state visits"}]}
